_about: Public-domain A. T. Robertson (Archibald Thomas Robertson, 1863-1934), Southern Baptist Greek scholar, for the Word Hoard: his books printed before 1930, among them A Grammar of the Greek New Testament in the Light of Historical Research (copyright 1914), A Harmony of the Gospels (1922), Epochs in the Life of Jesus (1907) and of St. Paul (1909), the Life and Letters of John Albert Broadus (1901), Luke the Historian (1920), The Pharisees and Jesus (1920) and The Wisdom of James (1915), from Internet Archive scans and Project Gutenberg. Not James Craigie Robertson or F. W. Robertson. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 36 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted. Word Pictures vols. I-III (1930) added 2026-11-03 (1930 books are public domain since 2026); vol. IV (1931) is unrenewed and waits for a scan.

atrobertson-harmony: A Harmony of the Gospels for Students of the Life of Christ (New York and London: Harper & Brothers, copyright 1922)

atrobertson-grammar: A Grammar of the Greek New Testament in the Light of Historical Research (New York: George H. Doran; London: Hodder & Stoughton; copyright 1914)

atrobertson-epochs-paul: Epochs in the Life of St. Paul (London: Hodder and Stoughton, 1909)
atrobertson-broadus: Life and Letters of John Albert Broadus (Philadelphia: American Baptist Publication Society, 1901)
atrobertson-luke-historian: Luke the Historian in the Light of Research (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1920)
atrobertson-pharisees: The Pharisees and Jesus, the Stone Lectures for 1915-16 (New York: Charles Scribner's Sons, 1920)
atrobertson-wisdom-james: Practical and Social Aspects of Christianity: The Wisdom of James (New York: George H. Doran; copyright 1915)
atrobertson-word-pictures-1: Word Pictures in the New Testament, vol. 1: The Gospel according to Matthew; The Gospel according to Mark (New York: Richard R. Smith, 1930)

_alternates.atrobertson-copies: Another Grammar copy; the Doran Harmony (1922); Broadus's Harmony with his notes (1893) and revised by him (1903); A Short Grammar (copyright 1908, a later printing)

_excluded.atrobertson-later: Studies in the Epistle of James as revised by Peacock (PG 48411, 1959). Word Pictures vols. V (1932) and VI (1933) are RENEWED (R250625, R251316, 1960): US copyright to 2028 and 2029, on the wordhoard release queue's terms. Vols. I-III (1930) are on the shelf; vol. IV in _pending.
